tasks.label: Build APK & Copy to Downloads
tasks.command: flutter build apk --release && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk && echo 'APK copied to /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk'

tasks.label: Accept Android SDK Licenses
tasks.command: yes | /usr/lib/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses 2>&1 || yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses 2>&1 || yes | sdkmanager --licenses 2>&1

tasks.label: Build & Copy APK
tasks.command: flutter build apk --release && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk && echo 'APK copied to /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk'

tasks.label: Check opt SDK
tasks.command: find /opt/android-sdk -maxdepth 3 -name 'ndk' -o -name 'ndk-bundle' 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '---'; ls /opt/android-sdk/

tasks.label: Build APK (opt SDK)
tasks.command: flutter build apk --release && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: APK copied to /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk'

tasks.label: Build APK forced opt
tasks.command: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk flutter build apk --release && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: APK copied to /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk'

tasks.label: Flutter precache ARM64
tasks.command: flutter precache --android 2>&1 && echo 'PRECACHE DONE'

tasks.label: Build APK final
tasks.command: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk flutter build apk --release && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: APK copied to /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk'

tasks.label: Check gen_snapshot cache
tasks.command: find /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release -type f 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; uname -m

tasks.label: Symlink gen_snapshot arm64
tasks.command: for dir in android-arm-release android-arm64-release android-x64-release; do ln -sfn /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/$dir/linux-x64 /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/$dir/linux-arm64 && echo "Linked $dir"; done

tasks.label: Build APK symlinked
tasks.command: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk flutter build apk --release && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: APK copied to /sdcard/Download/taskstack.apk'

tasks.label: Check x64 emulators
tasks.command: which box64 qemu-x86_64 qemu-x86_64-static 2>/dev/null; echo '---file check:'; file /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release/linux-x64/gen_snapshot

tasks.label: Get Flutter engine hash
tasks.command: cat /opt/flutter/bin/internal/engine.version; echo '---'; flutter --version 2>/dev/null | head -3

tasks.label: Download ARM64 gen_snapshot
tasks.command: HASH=6c0baaebf70e0148f485f27d5616b3d3382da7bf; BASE=/opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine; for target in android-arm-release android-arm64-release android-x64-release; do echo "=== Downloading $target ==="; rm -rf $BASE/$target/linux-arm64; mkdir -p $BASE/$target/linux-arm64; curl -fL "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/flutter/$HASH/$target/linux-arm64.zip" -o /tmp/arm64_${target}.zip && unzip -o /tmp/arm64_${target}.zip -d $BASE/$target/linux-arm64/ && echo "OK: $target" || echo "FAIL: $target"; done

tasks.label: Build Debug APK
tasks.command: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk flutter build apk --debug && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack-debug.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: debug APK at /sdcard/Download/taskstack-debug.apk'

tasks.label: Verify arch
tasks.command: echo '=== Flutter binaries ==='; file /opt/flutter/bin/flutter; echo ''; file /opt/flutter/bin/cache/dart-sdk/bin/dart; echo ''; echo '=== gen_snapshot ==='; file /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release/linux-x64/gen_snapshot; echo ''; file /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm-release/linux-x64/gen_snapshot; echo ''; echo '=== uname ==='; uname -m

tasks.label: Check engine arches
tasks.command: ls -la /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'linux|apple|windows'; echo '---'; find /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release -type d -maxdepth 1 2>/dev/null

tasks.label: Check linux-arm64 dir
tasks.command: ls -la /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release/linux-arm64/; echo ''; file /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release/linux-arm64/gen_snapshot

tasks.label: Build debug APK clean
tasks.command: rm -rf /opt/flutter/bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-*-release/linux-arm64; ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk flutter build apk --debug --split-debug-info=/tmp/flutter_debug && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack-debug.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: debug APK at /sdcard/Download/taskstack-debug.apk'

tasks.label: Build APK NDK fixed
tasks.command: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk flutter build apk --debug --split-debug-info=/tmp/flutter_debug && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk /sdcard/Download/taskstack-debug.apk && echo 'SUCCESS: debug APK at /sdcard/Download/taskstack-debug.apk'

tasks.label: Verify APK copied
tasks.command: ls -lh /sdcard/Download/taskstack* 2>/dev/null && echo 'APK ready for installation'
